story.fullStory:
Ween's "Freedom Of '76" — original release 2000. Ween is an American rock band from New Hope, Pennsylvania, formed in 1984 by Aaron Freeman and Mickey Melchiondo, better known by their respective stage names, Gene Ween and Dean Ween.

Artist: Ween · Title: Freedom of '76 · Album: Chocolate And Cheese · Year: 1994 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Ween - Freedom of '76.mp4.

Generally categorized as an alternative rock band, the band are known for their irreverent, highly eclectic catalog of songs inspired by funk, psychedelia, soul, country, gospel, prog, R&B, heavy metal, and punk rock.

Ween self-released several cassette albums from their formation until 1989.
